heroSubtitle: Optimize operational expenditure with a structured procurement workflow: requisition approvals, RFQ comparisons, and strict three-way matching.
heroBoxDesc: Zero payment without physical receipt validation.
visionDesc: Empower your procurement department with real-time vendor insights, contract tracking, and strict budgetary controls.

features.title: Purchase Requisitions & Multi-Level Approvals
features.desc: Enable departments to submit purchase requests routed through configurable approval hierarchies based on budget thresholds.

features.title: Vendor RFQs & Comparison Matrix
features.desc: Compare vendor quotation terms, unit costs, payment facilities, and lead times to select optimal procurement terms.

features.title: Strict 3-Way Matching Verification
features.desc: Automatic validation comparing Purchase Order against Goods Received Note and Vendor Invoice to prevent financial discrepancies.

features.title: Vendor Registry & Performance Scoring
features.desc: Centralized vendor profiles with tax IDs, commercial records, and performance ratings based on punctuality and quality adherence.

features.title: Payables Management & Cash Outflow Planning
features.desc: Track credit terms, payment schedules, and post-dated checks to forecast cash requirements accurately.

features.title: Landed Cost & Landed Expenses Allocation
features.desc: Distribute freight, customs, clearance, and insurance overheads directly onto SKU unit cost for accurate margin analysis.

workflowTitle: Procurement Cycle from Request to Payment

steps.title: Purchase Request
steps.desc: Submit requisition and obtain management approval.

steps.title: Quotation & PO
steps.desc: Evaluate vendor quotes and issue certified PO.

steps.title: Goods Receipt & Inspection
steps.desc: Verify shipment physical count and register stock in warehouse.

steps.title: 3-Way Match & Pay
steps.desc: Execute three-way match and schedule accounting payment.

closingTitle: Ready to Optimize Your Corporate Spend?
closingDesc: Contact our procurement specialists and schedule a tailored live demonstration today.
